hooks.name: Deny publish and deploy
hooks.description: Blocks npm/pnpm publish, eas submit/update, terraform apply/destroy and tile uploads. Publishing and deploying are human-approved steps.

action.command: in=$(cat); c=$(printf '%s' "$in" | jq -r '.. | .command? // empty' 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); [ -n "$c" ] || c="$in"; if printf '%s' "$c" | grep -Eiq '(^|[;&|(]|[[:space:]])((npm|pnpm|yarn|bun) +([^;&|]* )?publish|eas +(submit|update)|(terraform|tofu) +([^;&|]* )?(apply|destroy)|aws +s3 +(cp|sync|mv|rm) .*tiles)'; then echo 'deny-publish-deploy: publishing and deploying are human steps. Prepare the change and stop; run it yourself.' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
